note: Machine-readable accepted exceptions for the fail-closed dependency advisory gate. Each entry must carry advisory id, module, vulnerable version, reachability rationale, owner and expiry. An expired, mismatched or missing entry leaves the advisory BLOCKING. Human-readable policy: docs/DEPENDENCY_SCAN.md. The id/url pair records the pnpm numeric advisory id and the real GitHub advisory it resolves to.

exceptions.rationale: Dev-chain only: zod is an EXACT-pinned transitive dependency of the @deepseek-ai/dsh-commands@0.2.1-rc.2 host devDependency (test replica of the audited host cohort). This package ships no runtime dependency on zod, and the advisory (memory exhaustion validating oversized constrained collections) requires attacker-controlled oversized schema input, which the deterministic local test fixtures never provide. Re-evaluate at the next host cohort bump, which is expected to carry zod >=4.6.6. The pinned @deepseek-ai 0.2.1-rc.3 host cohort (verified registry manifests) still exact-pins this same version, so upgrading the host does not lift the exception.

Dev-chain only: undici is an EXACT-pinned transitive dependency of @deepseek-ai/dsh-http-proxy@0.2.1-rc.2 under the pinned host devDependencies (test replica of the audited host cohort). This package ships no runtime dependency on undici, and the advisory (unhandled error on excessive content-encodings) requires an attacker-controlled server sending crafted Content-Encoding stacks, which the offline deterministic tests never contact. Re-evaluate at the next host cohort bump, which is expected to carry undici >=8.12.2. The pinned @deepseek-ai 0.2.1-rc.3 host cohort (verified registry manifests) still exact-pins this same version, so upgrading the host does not lift the exception.

Explicit maintainer-authorized temporary residual-risk and exception-eligibility waiver for the 0.11.0 validation, not an unreachability finding. Cache/redirect poisoning and cross-user disclosure: the inspected dsh-http-proxy factory does not construct cache stores or cache/redirect composition. This only narrows that inspected path; arbitrary host/plugin dispatchers were not proven absent. The development SDK and signed official rc.3 host retain the affected exact pin. Signed-host bytes remain unfixed; a development override does not repair them. Acceptance is limited to this advisory/version pair through 2026-11-05 inclusive; the existing gate blocks again from 2026-11-06. Other findings, versions and release checks are not waived.
